name: Hanu Yokia
description: Hanu Yokia v2 is the HANU token of the Goji Crypto ecosystem, issued natively on Robinhood Chain and managed by Goji Crypto Holdings LLC. Every administrative power is a named role held by the company multisig; fee increases, wallet changes and parameter loosening are announced at least one day ahead; lawful-order controls exist but are always public, provisional unless ratified, and seizure only after public notice. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by Robinhood.

snapshot.note: Every published version of this document is pinned to IPFS and its CID is recorded here and in the CHANGELOG. The on-chain event ContractURIUpdated() is emitted by governance when this document changes.

contracts.status: testnet only; no mainnet addresses exist yet. Anything claiming to be HANU v2 on mainnet before it is announced in the CHANGELOG is not ours.

token_facts.transfer_tax: 0 (default); governed ceiling 10%; absolute fence 15%; increases announced at least 1 day ahead
token_facts.pause: time-boxed, at most 7 days per window, cooldown proportional to time paused
token_facts.minting: proposal, N approvals, delay, execution window; tokens can only land in approved company wallets
token_facts.compliance: provisional freeze thaws after 14 days unless ratified with notice; seizure or destruction only from a ratified freeze after a 7-day public announcement

links.restricted_jurisdictions_notice: Stock Tokens on Robinhood Chain are a separate product of Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Limited and are not available to US persons; HANU is a utility token of the Goji ecosystem and is not a stock token.
